## Project Overview

Interpreting the functional impact of genomic variants is a major challenge in genomics and precision medicine. While sequencing technologies can identify millions of variants, determining which ones are likely to disrupt molecular function remains difficult.

Our **Variant Effect Dashboard** creates an interactive tool that makes known variant information from multiple sources easily accessible in one space. It also aims to improve the prediction of a variant’s clinical effects through a machine learning model.  

Of note, due to file size limitations, the current dataset is restricted to the first 10% (470,000) known variants on Chr1. If you are looking to explore the tool, Chr 1:925946 (SMAD11) could be a place to start.

---


## Key Project Features

### Variant Information Page

Combines genomic context, functional annotations, population frequency statistics, gene ontology information, and literary evidence into a single, interactive presentation of a specific variant.
Users enter a chromosome and genomic position to retrieve specific variant information in mini cards.

---

### Variant Effect Prediction Page

Summarizes computational evidence for the functional impact of a selected genetic variant, including SIFT, PolyPhen, FATHMM, and CADD pathogenicity scores, as well as our achine learning model GVPS. Provides a consensus interpretation of predicted clinical effect classification.

---

### Variant Feature Explorer Pages

#### Machine Learning Explorer Page

Supports broad exploration of the full set of machine learning–predicted variants, enabling users to move fluidly from high-level patterns to specific subsets of interest.

#### Ranking Page

Allows users to quickly identify the most extreme or biologically interesting variants according to any numeric metric in the dataset.

#### Distribution Page

Provides distributional visualizations for key GVPS metrics.

#### Variant Detail Page

Creates a concise summary table of key fields for a given variant, allowing for easy download of information.

---

### Predict on Uploaded Data Page

Extends the dashboard beyond our curated dataset, allowing users to upload their own variant files and obtain machine learning-based predictions using the same trained models used in the main application.
